subject: P7.2 terrain streaming immutable Matter exclusion-bounds forwarding
authorized_change: Forward an immutable duplicate of get_streaming_matter_exclusion_bounds() into the existing terrain build request so the existing worker path applies the same P7.2 body-fixed seam clip as synchronous generation.
forbidden_expansion: No scheduler or cache policy redesign
rationale: The final physical seam repair must remain valid after local-cap recenter and worker generation. The four-line forwarding is behavior-preserving when no Matter adapter is installed and is required to keep sync/worker seam semantics identical.
